dataset: Ofgem RIIO-ED2 Final Determinations Finance Annex (30 November 2022)
modelling_use: Item N6/G2: Appendix 5 gives per-DNO opening and closing RAV, return, tax allowance and calculated revenue in GBP m 20/21 prices, CPIH real. Sector RAV 62.3bn period average, return 2.44bn/yr (3.92% of RAV, reproducing the published 3.93% vanilla WACC), tax 0.74bn/yr, allowed revenue 11.27bn/yr. Extracted by scripts/consumer_bill/extract_network_price_control_building_blocks.py

dataset: Ofgem RIIO-3 Final Determinations Finance Annex (4 December 2025)

WACC 5.64% unweighted average is SEMI-NOMINAL, not comparable with the CPIH-real ED2 3.93% without conversion
